name: Adithya R B
description: Computer Engineering Student | Exploring Ideas Through Code
bio: I'm a second-year Computer Engineering student with a growing interest in software development and game development. I enjoy exploring ideas, solving problems, and building interactive experiences. My current project, Era Escape, is a Java Swing puzzle game that brings logic and creativity together. I'm always learning and looking forward to building more projects.

projects.name: Era Escape
projects.description: A Java Swing escape-room puzzle game where players solve logic challenges, explore different levels, use hints, and race against a timer. The game features an Ancient Greece-themed Level 7 and a shared global lives system.
